recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Vocabulary later changes the intended regex semantics or moves ISO 3166 value set ownership; handle FHIR-39157 separately if a tooling/publication audit is needed.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Vocabulary issue for R5 asking that the ISO 3166 Part 1 2-letter value set be changed from a fixed enumeration to an include from urn:iso:std:iso:3166 where code matches regex [A-Z]{2}, aligning it with the 3-letter and numeric ISO value sets.
initial_application: Git commit 6331a8ed4511453b1ab875cdaeab1588febe3f70, 'Applied FHIR-37971', removed the fixed country-code concepts from source/terminologies/valueset-iso3166-1-2.xml and added the requested code regex filter.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes iso3166-1-2, so the checked XML feeds the current build. The Jira resolution URL appears to typo iso3166-1-3, but the description, tracker-call comment, Confluence minutes, and implementation commit all identify the 2-letter value set as the target. Later same-family issue FHIR-39157 concerns erroneous terminology-server expansion output and was resolved as tooling/publication, not as a missing source CLD edit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The existing source/terminologies/valueset-iso3166-1-2.xml compose include already filters urn:iso:std:iso:3166 by code regex [A-Z]{2}.
